existing_suite: EvaluationSuite with heldout/holdout/test population and immutable version/digest

inference.runtime: existing LocalInferenceEngine with cache disabled; no provider SDK, credential, network, tool or production execution authority
inference.roles: candidate generator, pinned baseline generator and distinct local verifier, each bound to exact model/runtime/training identity and observed receipt-bound training document fingerprints
inference.verifier_input: canonical prompt and actual generated answer; expected answer/gold correctness label excluded
inference.verifier_output: one bounded JSON object with exactly decision and confidence; decision accept/reject, finite numeric confidence in [0.5,1], duplicate keys, booleans, nonfinite values, extra fields and trailing output rejected
inference.gold_predicate: one casefold-based expected-substring predicate shared with existing EvaluationHarness and learning runner
inference.measurement: actual candidate/baseline/verifier outputs and token counts plus measured monotonic elapsed nanoseconds, exact input/result/model/suite identities
inference.runtime_identity: Bounded serialized local weights plus Python backend class/helper/override code, defaults, captured configuration and referenced local helper functions; fingerprint changes fail before reuse

metrics.calibration: empirical ten-bin expected calibration error over probability-of-accept derived from parsed decision confidence; Brier score also recorded
metrics.errors: false accept over gold-negative samples, false reject over gold-positive samples, and same-case correlated wrong accepts across candidate and baseline
metrics.comparison: actual candidate and baseline gold accuracies, with explicit bounded regression policy pinned before inference
metrics.coverage: both positive and negative labeled samples required by declared gate

contamination.checks: observed normalized heldout prompt/full labeled sample fingerprints against exact training document sequence bound by original training receipt or canonical completed durable training artifact; optional gate rejects shared verifier/generator training document fingerprints
contamination.live_authority: canonical materialized training sources are checked for current rights/authority epoch before inference and before durable case publication and qualification/reusable verifier admission
contamination.limits: exact normalized sample and shared-document checks only; no semantic overlap, external dataset completeness, factual label correctness or real-world bias proof

persistence.authority: append-only measured extension tables on the existing EvaluationLedger SQLite connection and lock; no second durable registry owner
persistence.transactions: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, durable WAL/FULL settings, run lease epochs and expiry fences, exact immutable intake binding and contiguous completed case sequence
persistence.recovery: completed case evidence is validated and reused without repeating local inference; uncommitted local work may be retried; stale workers cannot commit or qualify
persistence.integrity: strict bounded canonical JSON, exact schema/key validation and complete output/classification/metric/qualification rederivation; malformed or tampered evidence fails closed
persistence.qualification: registry-issued completed measured receipt handles only; caller-supplied VerifierReport rates or approval flags cannot issue measured qualification; publication requires a runner-issued private execution capability and live exact candidate/baseline/verifier source identities
persistence.scope: candidate qualification and reusable local inference proposal only, production_promotion_authorized always false
